lines.text: Two sisters from the same mother, Oholah and Oholibah, began prostituting themselves in Egypt, and Oholah stands for Samaria.
Oholah lusted after the Assyrians and defiled herself with all the idols of those she desired.
God delivered Oholah to the Moabites, who seized her sons and daughters and put her to the sword.
Oholibah saw Chaldean men engraved on a wall, sent soldiers to them, and then turned away in disgust.
God said Oholibah would drink her sister Samaria's cup, a deep and wide cup of devastation and desolation.
